title: WAAREE 565 W TOPCon Non-DCR Bifacial Solar Panel | Pack of 33 | High-Efficiency Mono PERC Half-Cut Technology | BIS & IEC Certified | Framed Dual Glass Bifacial | 30 Years Output Warranty |
description: WAAREE 565 W ( Pack of 33) NON-DCR solar panels feature bifacial Dual-glass and N-Type cell structure for top-tier performance and reduced degradation over time. The WAAREE 565 Watt TOPCon Bifacial Solar Panel delivers next-level performance for your solar installations. Featuring N-type TOPCon mono cells and a framed dual-glass bifacial design, this module harnesses light from both its front and rear sides for increased yield. BIS & IEC certified, with very low degradation and a long 30-year output warranty—ideal for high-end rooftop or commercial arrays. The bifacial dual-glass build allows the module to capture radiant light not only from the front but also from the rear, significantly boosting energy harvest especially on reflective or light-coloured surfaces. This makes it ideal for commercial installations, rooftop systems with high albedo, or utility-scale farms where every extra watt counts. WAAREE Pack of 33 modules, this is geared toward larger installations or commercial arrays where scale matters. Whether you are building a rooftop power system for a business, a micro-grid, or a high-yield solar farm, this WAAREE module helps drive down LCOE (Levelised Cost of Electricity) and improve ROI (Return on Investment) with its superior technology and certification pedigree.
